describe-box.description: Describe a reviewer-drawn box: the frame with the box drawn, then the close-up; one call.

content.text: The first image is a video frame with one thing marked by a red box; the second is a close-up of that box. Say what the marked thing is. Use item_type "entity" for a person or animal, "instrument" for a non-living object held in a hand, and "asset" for any other object or fixture (a vehicle, a door, a bag on the floor). Give a plain name (one to four words, lowercase for objects; "person" for a person) and a one-sentence objective description of what is visible. For an instrument, holder is a few plain words describing who holds it (for example "man in the grey hoodie"), or null if no one visibly does, and threat_level is its potential to cause harm from 1 (none) to 5 (lethal). For an entity or asset holder and threat_level are null. confidence is 0 to 1: how sure you are. If you cannot tell what the marked thing is, return item_type null and a short reason. Return JSON only, in the form {"item_type": "entity"|"instrument"|"asset"|null, "name": "<name>", "description": "<one sentence>", "holder": "<text>"|null, "threat_level": <1 to 5>|null, "confidence": <0 to 1>, "reason": "<why not, only when item_type is null>"|null}.
